narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Priority Score = (0.25 x Gap Size) + (0.20 x Peer Comparison) + (0.15 x Strategic Alignment) + (0.15 x Implementation Complexity Inverse) + (0.15 x Investment Efficiency) + (0.10 x Stakeholder Readiness)
narrative.roadmap_md: The transformation roadmap organizes all 10 recommendations into three sequential phases plus an ongoing talent program. Phase 1 Foundation (months 1-6) establishes MuleSoft integration, GRC validation, and cloud strategy. Phase 2 Integration (months 4-12) deploys Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and BI consolidation. Phase 3 Intelligence (months 9-18) delivers Data Cloud, Agentforce, and Financial Services Cloud. Each phase builds on the previous, with overlapping timelines allowing parallel workstreams.
